C0251.title: Web Novel Scraping Case: Li Sentenced for Writing Crawler Scripts to Steal Novels
C0251.summary: In February 2025, a 27-year-old software test engineer surnamed Li in Taicang, Jiangsu Province, exploited his technical skills to write crawler scripts that illegally scraped original content from a web novel platform and provided it to readers for free.
